claims.text: Heparin bleed: protamine stops or slows it;
claims.quote: With the heparins, bleeding can be stopped or slowed with protamine

claims.text: more effective on UFH than LMWH (only partially neutralizes LMWH).
claims.quote: It is more effective on unfractionated heparin (UFH) than on low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) because protamine only partially neutralizes LMWH inactivation of factor Xa

claims.text: Watch for hypotension and an anaphylaxis-like rxn during infusion.
claims.quote: During all infusions, patients should be observed for hypotension and a reaction similar to an anaphylactic reaction
